book_channels.strc_jr: Listed STRC / JR as emergency dollars — not a GFS valve

nodes.title: USD liquidity
facts: Post-2022 QT + TGA rebuild + scarce reserves is the default USD funding regime unless a facility offsets it.
Offshore dollar (swap, basis) is how tightness shows up before the FOMC statement.
nodes.interpretation: Hinge node. Tight USD funding transmits into carry, crypto, and HY before it shows in headline payrolls.
nodes.watch_if: SOFR-FF widens, RRP near zero with TGA rising, or FX basis blows out.

nodes.title: Real policy / term rates
facts: Real rates are the discount factor on duration and on every long-duration risk asset, including BTC as a duration-like collateral.
nodes.interpretation: A cut that does not drop *real* rates (sticky inflation) is not a release valve.
nodes.watch_if: TIPS 10y or 5y5y re-prices >25bp in a week without a matching valve.

nodes.title: Credit spreads (HY / IG)
facts: HY OAS is the market's private-sector stress gauge; it can stay tight while public-sector plumbing is already stressed.
nodes.interpretation: Do not treat equity-at-ATH as 'system healthy' if HY is the only calm node.
nodes.watch_if: HY OAS +75bp in 10 sessions or IG CDX jumps with treasury_function stress.

nodes.title: Treasury / collateral function
facts: UST market function (MOVE, futures basis, coupon supply) is the collateral backbone of USD credit.
nodes.interpretation: A disorderly UST tape is a pressure even if equities ignore it for a week. 2020 and 2023 were the lesson.
nodes.watch_if: MOVE >130 or on-the-run / off-the-run dislocations without buybacks.

nodes.title: BoJ / JPY carry
facts: USDJPY and JGB yields are a global carry hinge; 2024 unwind showed it hits US risk assets the same session.
nodes.interpretation: A BoJ hike or lost-control JPY is a *pressure* on USD liquidity, not a Japan-only story.
nodes.watch_if: USDJPY >10-day realized vol spike + JGB 10y unanchored.

nodes.title: China credit impulse
facts: China property/credit impulse is still the second engine of global demand and of industrial metals / energy.
nodes.interpretation: A CNY slide without a PBOC/fiscal valve is deflationary for the world and tightening for commodity-exporters.
nodes.watch_if: New TSF / credit impulse prints negative while CNY breaks a prior range.

nodes.title: Energy shock
facts: Brent / Henry Hub shocks re-price inflation expectations and therefore the room for the Fed valve to open.
nodes.interpretation: Energy is a pressure *on real rates* and on fiscal; it is not itself a valve.
nodes.watch_if: Brent +15% in 15 sessions with no SPR/OPEC offset.

nodes.title: Fed balance sheet / standing facilities
facts: QT, QE, SRF, and standing repo are the primary official USD release valves. Rate cuts without balance-sheet or facility use may not vent funding stress.
nodes.interpretation: Treat 'Fed put' as this node, not as the funds rate alone.
nodes.watch_if: SRF take-up jumps, QT taper, or a named facility is announced.

nodes.title: TGA / RRP plumbing
facts: TGA draw and RRP drain inject reserves without an FOMC vote. They are mechanical valves, not policy signals.
nodes.interpretation: Do not confuse a TGA draw (valve open) with a Fed easing cycle.
nodes.watch_if: TGA weekly change >$80B or RRP < $100B while QT still runs.

nodes.title: CB FX swap lines
facts: Standing dollar swap lines are the offshore USD backstop. Usage is rare and loud.
nodes.interpretation: If this valve opens, usd_liquidity is already in seize territory. That is a regime change, not a trade signal by itself.
nodes.watch_if: Any announced 7-day or 84-day dollar auction by Fed swap-line counterparties.

source.name: NY Fed — central bank swap arrangements

edges.note: Higher real rates re-price credit; spreads are the private-sector tell.
Scarce USD forces carry unwind through JPY.
Tight dollars hit BTC collateral and Morpho LTV the same week.
HY stress is the path into the brokerage sleeve.
QE / SRF / QT taper is the official vent.
Offshore dollar backstop — last official vent.
Energy up → inflation expectations → less room for the Fed valve.
Collateral stress raises the value of true cash / T-bill optionality.
Emergency-dollar sleeve, not a GFS valve.
